fields.title: iPhone / iPad 语音跟随提词器｜Oralo
fields.description: 照着步骤使用 Oralo 语音跟随：准备讲稿、检查收音与语言模型、开始和暂停、离稿后选句接回。含实际界面截图与常见问题。
fields.H1: iPhone 与 iPad 语音跟随提词器

paragraphs: 按下面的步骤，在 iPhone 或 iPad 上用 Oralo 跟随讲稿：先放入正文、检查语音，再试一次停顿和接稿。开始前，准备几句短稿即可。
faqs: 停顿或讲快一点，稿子跟得上吗？
设计上会在停顿时等待，并在你按稿继续时跟上。实际是否跟稳，取决于环境、设备、语言和已安装的系统模型。
想从指定的一句继续，怎么操作？
点「接稿」并选中一句，以你的选择为准。选句后仍为暂停状态，点「继续」重新监听。「上一句」和「下一句」可逐句移动。
没有网络能不能用语音跟随？
若系统模型已经下载在本机，语音跟随可以在设备端进行。第一次下载模型或声音可能需要联网。不能把这一点理解为全程无需联网，或所有功能都已离线验收。

steps.title: 新建或打开讲稿
steps.text: 在讲稿库点「新建讲稿」→「粘贴正文」，放入上面的三句示例。也可以先在本机下载示例，再点「新建讲稿」→「导入文件」选择 TXT 文件。

steps.title: 选对识别语言
steps.text: 在「备稿」页点右上角「…」→「识别语言」，按实际要说的内容选择「普通话」或「英语（美国）」。

image.alt: Oralo 讲稿库，含已保存讲稿和底部 New script 按钮
image.caption: 讲稿库截图：点已保存的讲稿，或使用底部 New script（新建讲稿）。
image.source: 原生界面截图 · Oralo 1.0（13）· iPhone 17 模拟器 · iOS 27.0 · 2026 年 11 月 20 日。

steps.title: 进入开始前检查
steps.text: 在「备稿」页底部点「开讲」。进入「开始前」后，点「检查语音跟随」，并允许 App 请求的权限。

steps.title: 完成设备准备
steps.text: 若出现「下载语音模型」，先联网下载，再重新检查。若出现「试用兼容识别」，可以尝试这一设备端选项。暂时无法准备好语音时，也可以选「仅手动开始」。

steps.title: 先读第一句
steps.text: 看到「设备端已就绪」后，点「开始演讲」。在安静环境里读出「今天，我来汇报一下项目进展。」，观察高亮位置是否跟着这句话前进。

image.alt: Oralo「开始前」页面，显示检查收音与检查语音跟随入口
image.caption: 「开始前」的收音和语音跟随检查。图中从排练入口进入，底部开始按钮与演讲入口不同。
image.source: 原生界面截图 · Oralo 1.0（10）· iPhone 模拟器 · iOS 27.0 · 2026 年 11 月 19 日。截图记录未注明具体 iPhone 型号。

sections.title: 3. 试一次停顿、离稿和接回

steps.title: 自然停顿一次
steps.text: 读完第一句后停顿一下，再读「本周，我们完成了第一版草稿，并整理了反馈。」跟随设计上会在停顿时等待。想主动停止监听，点「暂停」；准备好后点「继续」。

steps.title: 用原稿内容接回
steps.text: 临时用自己的话补充一句，再读回原稿：「接下来，我们会测试修改，并在周五确认计划。」观察 Oralo 是否接回原句；不保证能跳到任意较远段落。

steps.title: 位置不对，自己选一句
steps.text: 如果位置不对，点「接稿」，选中以「接下来，我们会测试修改」开头的第三句。选句后仍为暂停状态，点「继续」再读一次。「上一句」和「下一句」可逐句调整。

image.alt: Oralo 实际阅读界面，高亮当前字词并显示音标提示
image.caption: 阅读界面会标出当前位置；这张截图展示的是隐藏操作栏后的文字视图。
image.source: 原生界面截图 · Oralo 1.0（9）· iPhone 17 模拟器 · iOS 27.0 · 2026 年 11 月 18 日。

sections.note: 如果之前隐藏了操作栏，点一下阅读区域即可重新显示。

sections.title: 4. 长时间使用前，先排查这几项

items.title: 读了，但位置没动
items.text: 检查识别语言、麦克风权限和开始前检查结果。靠近设备、减少背景声，再读一小句原稿。若位置不对，用「接稿」→选句→「继续」重新定位。

items.title: 语音暂时无法启动
items.text: 按「开始前」页面提示下载模型或尝试兼容识别；也可以选「仅手动开始」，通过手动切句继续阅读。

items.title: 准备离线使用
items.text: 编辑和阅读使用本机数据。语音跟随需要可用的设备端识别及对应语言模型，首次下载可能需要联网；识别不可用时不会自动改用云端上传音频。

sections.note: 需要切换到其他 App 录像时，请按小窗提词指南操作。它的麦克风行为和已验证范围与 App 内阅读不同。

fields.title: Voice-Following Teleprompter for iPhone & iPad | Oralo
fields.description: Set up Oralo voice following on iPhone or iPad: add a script, check the microphone, start speaking, pause and choose a line to pick up again.

paragraphs: Follow these steps to read a script with Oralo on iPhone or iPad. Add your text, check voice following, then practice pausing and picking up a line. Have a short script ready before you start.
faqs: If I pause or speed up, will it stay with me?
It is designed to wait when you pause and to follow when you continue from the script. How steady that feels depends on your environment, device, language, and installed system model.
How do I choose exactly where to continue?
Tap Pick up and choose a sentence. Your selection takes priority and leaves following paused; tap Resume to listen again. Back and Next move one sentence at a time.
Can I use voice following offline?

If the system model is already on your device, voice following can run on-device. The first download of a model or voice may need the internet. This is not a claim that every feature works fully offline, or that offline use has been independently verified end to end.

sections.title: 1. Put a short script in Oralo

steps.title: Create or open a script
steps.text: In your library, tap New script → Paste text and add the three sentences above. Or download the sample on this device, then choose New script → Import file and select the TXT file.

steps.title: Match the speech language
steps.text: On the Prepare screen, open the top-right (…) menu → Speech language. Choose Mandarin or English (US) to match what you will say.

image.alt: Oralo script library with a saved Quarterly report and the New script button
image.caption: The script library. Open a saved script or use New script at the bottom.
image.source: Native UI capture · Oralo 1.0 (13) · iPhone 17 simulator · iOS 27.0 · 20 Nov 2026.

steps.title: Open the readiness check
steps.text: Tap Start speaking at the bottom of Prepare. On Before you start, tap Check voice following and allow the permissions requested by the app.

steps.title: Finish device setup
steps.text: If Download speech model appears, download it while online and check again. If Try compatibility recognition is offered, you can try that on-device option. Start manually is available if voice following cannot be prepared.

steps.title: Read the first sentence
steps.text: When you see Ready on this device, tap Start speaking. In a quiet place, read “Today I’ll share a short update on our project.” Check that the highlighted position follows those words.

image.alt: Oralo Before you start screen showing microphone and voice-following checks in Chinese
image.caption: Before you start: check the microphone and voice following. This capture is from the rehearsal entry; its start button differs from Start speaking.
image.source: Native UI capture · Oralo 1.0 (10) · iPhone simulator · iOS 27.0 · 19 Nov 2026. The capture record does not specify the iPhone model.

sections.title: 3. Pause, go off script, and pick up again

steps.title: Try a natural pause
steps.text: After the first sentence, pause briefly, then read “This week, we completed the first draft and reviewed the feedback.” Following is designed to wait during the pause. To stop listening explicitly, tap Pause; tap Resume when ready.

steps.title: Return with the original wording
steps.text: Add a short comment in your own words. Then return with “Next, we will test the changes and confirm the plan on Friday.” Watch whether Oralo picks up the original wording; a jump to a distant paragraph is not guaranteed.

steps.title: Choose a line yourself
steps.text: If the position is wrong, tap Pick up and select the third sentence, beginning “Next, we will test…”. This leaves following paused. Tap Resume and read that sentence again. Back and Next adjust the position one sentence at a time.

image.alt: Actual Oralo reading screen with the current word highlighted and an IPA pronunciation hint
image.caption: The reading view shows your place in the script. This capture shows the text view with controls hidden.
image.source: Native UI capture · Oralo 1.0 (9) · iPhone 17 simulator · iOS 27.0 · 18 Nov 2026.

sections.note: If you hid the controls, tap the reading area to show them again.

sections.title: 4. Check these before a longer talk

items.title: The words are not moving
items.text: Check the selected speech language, microphone permission and readiness result. Move closer to the device, reduce background noise, and try a short sentence from the script. Use Pick up → select a sentence → Resume if your place is wrong.

items.title: Voice setup is unavailable
items.text: Follow the model-download or compatibility option shown on Before you start. You can use Start manually to read and change sentences without voice recognition.

items.title: You want to work offline
items.text: Editing and reading use local data. Voice following requires an available on-device recognizer and its language model. The first model download can need internet access; unavailable recognition does not switch to cloud audio upload.

sections.note: For a recording in another app, use the floating-prompt guide. Its microphone behavior and tested app coverage are different from reading inside Oralo.

fields.title: iPhone / iPad 小窗提词器与画中画提词｜Oralo
fields.description: 从备稿页开启 Oralo 小窗提词，逐步设置定速滚动或语音跟随，了解切换 App、中断后重启和已有实测的兼容范围。
fields.H1: iPhone 与 iPad 小窗提词器

paragraphs: 把讲稿放进 iPhone 或 iPad 的画中画小窗，再切换 App。下面分别介绍定速滚动、语音跟随的开启步骤，以及中断恢复和已有实测的范围。
faqs: 小窗提词的入口在哪里？
在 Oralo 打开一篇讲稿，进入「备稿」，点右上角「…」→「小窗提词」。它与底部「开讲」是不同入口。
可以和相机、直播或通话一起用吗？
系统相机拍照预览已在 iPhone 15 Pro／iOS 18.1 验证。另有用户确认录像时跟随与录制人声正常，但未提供完整设备与 App 清单。直播和通话 App 不在已验证范围内，请先用自己的环境录一小段并回放。
返回 Oralo 后，麦克风还会继续监听吗？
不会。返回会暂停提词并停止语音收音。重新在 Oralo 内检查语音后，再开启小窗并切换 App。若另一款 App 反复中断收音，可以试试不需要麦克风的定速滚动。

steps.title: 准备讲稿
steps.text: 在讲稿库点「新建讲稿」→「粘贴正文」，放入上面的三句示例。也可以先在本机下载示例，再点「新建讲稿」→「导入文件」选择 TXT 文件。在「备稿」页点「…」→「识别语言」→「普通话」。

steps.title: 进入小窗提词
steps.text: 在「备稿」页点右上角「…」→「小窗提词」，选择「定速滚动」或「语音跟随」。如果小窗已经开启，需要先关闭小窗才能切换模式。

image.alt: Oralo 备稿页截图，右上角有省略号菜单
image.caption: 在备稿页打开右上角「…」，然后选择「小窗提词」。
image.source: 原生界面截图 · Oralo 1.0（13）· iPhone 17 模拟器 · iOS 27.0 · 2026 年 11 月 20 日。

sections.title: 2A. 使用定速滚动
sections.intro: 按自己设定的速度滚动，不使用麦克风。想先熟悉小窗，可以从这个模式开始。

steps.title: 选起点，调速度和字号
steps.text: 选「定速滚动」，点「选择起点」并选中第一句「今天，我来汇报一下项目进展。」调整「滚动速度」和「文字大小」，点「预览滚动」，试读完整三句并调到舒服的速度。「暂停预览」可停下。

steps.title: 开启小窗，再切换 App
steps.text: 点「开启小窗」。经过 3 秒倒计时后，文字开始滚动。切换到要使用的 App，同时保留小窗。在另一款 App 里读完前两句，确认小窗始终可见。

steps.title: 调整位置
steps.text: 把系统画中画窗口移到不遮挡重要操作的位置。如果相机把小窗收到了屏幕边缘，点边缘箭头展开；双指捏合可在系统允许的范围内调整大小。

image.alt: iPad 主屏幕的实际截图，右上角显示 Oralo 小窗讲稿
image.caption: iPad 实际截图：离开 Oralo 后，讲稿显示在独立画中画窗口中。这张图展示小窗布局，不代表相机录像兼容性验证。
image.source: 原生界面测试截图 · Oralo 1.0（13）· iPad Pro 11 英寸（M5）模拟器 · iPadOS 27.0 · 2026 年 11 月 20 日。

sections.title: 2B. 使用小窗语音跟随
sections.intro: 先让 Oralo 留在前台完成语音准备，再切换到其他 App。

steps.title: 选择语音跟随
steps.text: 在小窗关闭的状态下选「语音跟随」。用「选择起点」选中示例的第一句，再调整「文字大小」。

steps.title: 先在 Oralo 内试读
steps.text: 点「试试语音跟随」，允许请求的权限。若出现「下载语音模型并重试」或「使用兼容识别重试」，按提示处理。先读一句，确认位置会跟随，再离开 Oralo。按示例读第一句，停顿后再读第二句。

steps.title: 开启小窗
steps.text: 点「开启小窗」，等语音准备完成、小窗打开后，再切换 App。先在另一个 App 里读几句，确认状态后再开始较长的录制。

sections.note: 定速滚动和语音跟随是两种独立模式。麦克风输入被中断时，语音模式会保留位置，不会悄悄改成定速滚动。

items.title: 小窗不再跟着声音走
items.text: 回到 Oralo，必要时关闭小窗。点「选择起点」，选中以「接下来，我们会测试修改」开头的第三句；点「试试语音跟随」并读出这一句，正常后再开启小窗。如果另一款 App 反复中断收音，关闭小窗后可改用「定速滚动」。

items.title: 回到了 Oralo
items.text: 返回 Oralo 会暂停提词并停止语音收音。需要继续时，重新开始预览或语音检查；仅重新打开页面不会自动恢复麦克风监听。

items.title: 小窗消失或打不开
items.text: 画中画能否使用、如何摆放由系统与另一款 App 共同决定。回到 Oralo 后可重试「开启小窗」；暂不可用时，可用 App 内预览或全屏提词。

image.alt: Oralo 小窗提词模式选择器，选中语音跟随并显示麦克风中断、位置保留状态
image.caption: 收音中断后的语音模式：保留原位置，并提供「试试语音跟随」和「选择起点」。此界面测试使用回放输入，不能证明跨 App 收音兼容性。
image.source: 原生界面测试截图 · Oralo 1.0（13）· iPhone 17 模拟器 · iOS 27.0 · 2026 年 11 月 20 日。

sections.title: 4. 哪些场景有实际验证
sections.intro: 请依据下面的范围，在自己的设备上先做一次短测试。小窗可见、能持续收音、成片中有正常人声，是三件需要分别确认的事。以下为所列版本的历史记录，不代表对后续每个版本重新完成了测试。

rows:
真机验证 · Oralo 1.0（13）
iPhone 15 Pro · iOS 18.1 · 系统相机拍照预览
2026 年 11 月 20 日
定速和语音模式下小窗文字保持可见，语音模式持续收到麦克风输入。
本次测试没有开始录像，也没有测量真实讲话的识别准确率。

用户反馈 · Oralo 1.0（14）
2026 年 11 月 21 日
用户确认小窗可用、录像时语音跟随正常、录制人声正常，以及离稿后能接回。
反馈没有附设备、系统、目标 App 和录制时长，不能据此确认某个具体 App 与设备组合的兼容性。

sections.note: 其他录像、直播、通话 App，以及长时间使用，尚无完整设备测试矩阵。上方 iPad 截图只展示界面。正式使用前，先录一小段并回放，分别检查提词状态和成片人声。

fields.title: Floating Teleprompter for iPhone & iPad | Oralo
fields.description: Open Oralo’s floating prompt from your script. Follow step-by-step setup for fixed pace or voice following, recover from interruptions, and check tested compatibility.

paragraphs: Put your script in a Picture-in-Picture window on iPhone or iPad. Choose a steady scroll or voice following, then switch apps. This guide covers both paths, interruption recovery and the setups that have actually been checked.
faqs: Where do I find Floating prompt?
Open a script in Oralo. On Prepare, tap the top-right (…) menu → Floating prompt. It is a separate entry from the Start speaking button.
Can I use it with Camera, a livestream or a call?

System Camera photo preview was checked on iPhone 15 Pro with iOS 18.1. Separate device feedback confirmed following during recording and normal recorded speech, without a full device/app matrix. Livestream and calling apps are not covered; test your own setup and play back a short recording first.
Does returning to Oralo keep the microphone running?

No. Returning pauses the prompt and stops voice capture. Check voice following again in Oralo before reopening the window and switching apps. If another app repeatedly interrupts input, try Fixed pace, which uses no microphone.

steps.title: Prepare your script
steps.text: In your library, tap New script → Paste text and add the three sentences above. Or download the sample on this device, then choose New script → Import file and select the TXT file. On Prepare, use (…) → Speech language → English (US).

steps.title: Enter Floating prompt
steps.text: On Prepare, open the top-right (…) menu → Floating prompt. Choose Fixed pace or Voice follow. Close an active floating window before changing modes.

image.alt: Oralo Prepare screen with the top-right three-dot menu
image.caption: Open (…) on Prepare, then choose Floating prompt.
image.source: Native UI capture · Oralo 1.0 (13) · iPhone 17 simulator · iOS 27.0 · 20 Nov 2026.

sections.title: 2A. Use fixed-pace scrolling
sections.intro: A steady scroll without microphone access. Start here if you want to set the speed yourself.

steps.title: Choose your starting point
steps.text: Select Fixed pace. Use Choose passage to select the first sentence, “Today I’ll share a short update on our project.” Adjust Scrolling speed and Text size, then tap Preview scrolling. Read all three sentences and adjust the speed until comfortable. Pause preview stops it.

steps.title: Open the window, then switch apps
steps.text: Tap Open floating window. A three-second countdown starts before the text scrolls. Switch to the app you want to use while keeping the window visible. Read the first two sentences in that app and check that the window stays visible.

steps.title: Check the framing
steps.text: Move the system Picture-in-Picture window away from important controls. If Camera tucks it against an edge, tap the edge arrow to bring it back. Pinch to resize within the sizes allowed by the system.

image.alt: Actual iPad home-screen capture with an Oralo floating script window in the top-right corner
image.caption: Actual iPad screen capture: the script stays in a separate Picture-in-Picture window after leaving Oralo. This image shows the window layout, not Camera recording compatibility.
image.source: Native UI test capture · Oralo 1.0 (13) · iPad Pro 11-inch (M5) simulator · iPadOS 27.0 · 20 Nov 2026.

sections.title: 2B. Let the window follow your voice
sections.intro: Prepare voice following while Oralo is still in the foreground, before switching to another app.

steps.title: Select Voice follow
steps.text: With the floating window closed, select Voice follow. Use Choose passage to select the first sentence of the sample and adjust Text size.

steps.title: Test a sentence in Oralo
steps.text: Tap Try voice following. Allow requested permissions and use Download speech model and retry or Retry with compatibility recognition if offered. Read a sentence and check the position before you leave Oralo. Read the first sentence of the sample, pause, then read the second.

steps.title: Open the window
steps.text: Tap Open floating window. Wait for voice preparation to finish and the window to open, then switch apps. Read a few lines in the other app before starting a longer take.

sections.note: Fixed pace and Voice follow are separate modes. If microphone input is interrupted, voice mode holds your place; it does not silently change into timed scrolling.

sections.title: 3. Return, restart, or fix an interruption

items.title: The script stops following
items.text: Return to Oralo and close the window if needed. In Choose passage, select the third sentence, beginning “Next, we will test…”. Tap Try voice following and read that sentence. Once it follows again, reopen the window. If the other app repeatedly interrupts input, close the window and try Fixed pace.

items.title: You return to Oralo
items.text: Returning pauses the prompt and stops voice capture. Start the preview or voice check again when you want to resume. Returning to the Floating prompt screen alone does not restart listening.

items.title: The window closes or cannot open
items.text: Picture-in-Picture availability and placement are controlled by the system and the other app. Return to Oralo and try Open floating window again. If unavailable, use the in-app preview or full-screen prompting.

image.alt: Oralo floating-prompt mode selector with Voice follow selected and Microphone interrupted, Position held status
image.caption: Voice follow after an input interruption: the place is held, with Try voice following and Choose passage available. This UI test replays input; it does not establish cross-app microphone compatibility.
image.source: Native UI test capture · Oralo 1.0 (13) · iPhone 17 simulator · iOS 27.0 · 20 Nov 2026.

sections.title: 4. What has actually been checked
sections.intro: Use these observations to plan a short check on your own setup. A visible window, live microphone input and audio in the saved recording are separate things to verify. These are historical observations for the versions shown, not a new test of every subsequent release.

rows:
Physical-device check · Oralo 1.0 (13)
